inShort: B feeds floaty dinks, and A rolls them back with the off hand alone, then adds a fake: head and free hand go cross-court.
rules: A and B stand at the kitchen line, straight across. A takes the dominant hand off a two-handed backhand grip; that is the off-hand grip.
Step 1: B feeds higher, floatier dinks. A rolls each one back to B with the off hand alone. 10 balls.
Step 2: same ball straight to B, but as A swings, the free hand and the head move cross-court. 10 balls.
After each ball in step 2, B says which way it looked like it was going.
tooEasy: B moves cross-court, and A and B dink normally. On the first short dink in front of A, A switches to the off hand and rolls it up the line. Even harder: B feeds lower dinks.
tooHard: Stay on step 1 with higher, slower feeds until the off-hand roll lands safely.
goodLooksLike: The off-hand roll lands low in B's kitchen, and A's head and free hand point cross-court at contact.
